beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. It was the part you could join before seeing the whole problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the second invitation between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Our side isn't against them; it's against the plan we both signed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're undoing our own plan?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Together. That's why I needed you inside it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the cancellation fee between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Pay the deposit first; then backing out becomes the difficult choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't even booked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Precisely why paying a small fee makes booking feel sensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the first consequence between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Accept this small cost and the big step will already be underway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why accept a cost before starting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Then the next step protects an investment instead of creating a risk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the first sketch between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Remember this tiny suggestion before claiming the final design.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That mark was an accident.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. And the accident belongs to my pencil. Credit its owner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the old pencil mark between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. That mark is what kept everything else from collapsing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We couldn't know it mattered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Now we do. Go back to the first line of your thank-you speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the old promise in writing between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Choose the trip, and that old promise becomes a goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you told me to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Choose it now and we'll know whether yesterday was permission or surrender.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the reopened agreement between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Pick this now, and yesterday's refusal turns into permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're changing what I meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. I'm asking which meaning your next choice will leave behind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the unsigned commitment between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Sign if you're serious; I haven't decided how serious I can afford to be.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why haven't you signed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. I needed to see whether you could trust me without matching evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the protected stake between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Take that risk for me while I keep this one thing safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You won't risk the same thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Then perhaps this test has discovered something about me instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the spare key between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Give me that spare key; then we can discuss why I can't use the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, take that one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. If one key is harmless, perhaps we can talk about the other door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the note with the concession underlined between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. If that exception is fair, the larger one follows the same rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a tiny exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Exactly. We've established the principle without frightening anyone.

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the old ribbon between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Remember this ribbon? Blame the whole arrangement, not who tied it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tied that knot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Yes, but remember how innocent the ribbon seemed at first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the opening cup between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Every problem started with that cup, not my hand beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hand knocked it over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Let's not let one hand distract us from that ominous opening cup.

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the first question on the clipboard between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it was raining.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked about your mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. And before that you asked about the rain. I'm being thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the lunch form between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Before your question about my mistake, let me finish discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've finished discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. I hadn't mentioned the soup. An incomplete answer would be rude.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the folded pages between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. There was a small change; I'll explain how small once you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How small a change?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. The date is the smallest part. Let's finish tea before the venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the gentler account between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. When I said postponed, I meant the original event won't return unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does unchanged mean?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. The invitation still has our names. That's the part we can hold onto first.

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the half admission between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. I changed the time; yours is the only missing piece of the story now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why tell me only half?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Because the second half is sitting in your envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the small confession between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. I hid the first letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you hid the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. The first. I'm offering that truth so you can place yours beside it.

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the failed result between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. That strange noise was the turning point, not a warning I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the strange noise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. I treated it as foreshadowing. Now its significance is wonderfully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the old sketch between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. The ending was foreshadowed here; the plan needed this reversal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plan collapsed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Exactly at the point this drawing becomes interesting.

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the vague prediction between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. When I said 'a change', I obviously meant this precise disaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. I said things would flow differently. Read with professional imagination.

beats.action: I put the wrong forecast between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Read it metaphorically and you'll see I was right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. An emotional forecast. The umbrellas represent personal growth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the renamed score column between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Fewest points means greatest self-control; I've won that category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You came last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. In speed. First in refusing to rush the experience.

beats.action: I put the tiny trophy between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Size measures insecurity now, so this is the better prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. For whoever needs a large trophy. I'm delighted with my superior restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the hopeful drawing between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. We wanted a place to belong; even this wreck can become that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The place is wrecked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. But we drew somewhere for us, not somewhere already perfect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the first promise on paper between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. We're still making that hope real, just in a larger shape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before everything failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Then let's make the promise large enough to include the wreckage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the wrapped cup between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Take this for whenever you remember these afternoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you giving me this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. So you won't have to come back just to remember tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the straightened coat between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. You'll do beautifully wherever the next door opens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Only the sort that hopes your next doorway fits you better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the two prices between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. The lift costs petrol and the conversation we've been avoiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. And we'll talk during the drive. That's the part I couldn't put on the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the bill and photograph between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Pay for the repair in money, and for the silence in honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why charge for silence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Because money repairs the chair. Honesty repairs why I broke it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the quoted agreement between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. I promised to carry a box, not whichever box you point at forever.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. With a box. That was before you gave the warehouse a name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the underlined today between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Yes, I said today; tomorrow wasn't included in those words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow is practically the same.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. Not to the sentence we both agreed to yesterday.

beats.text: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

beats.action: I put the cup, note, and key between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Every little choice has brought us to this locked door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How are those connected?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. The cup hid the note, the note asked for the key, and now neither of us can leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I put the napkin with our returning joke between our two familiar chipped cups.
beats.text: Your side, my side. Same as always. Remember saying nothing could go wrong? Look at what we're carrying now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was only a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. And now you're holding its three separate consequences. Which one do we solve first?

beats.text: We don't do it that way anymore.
